P19.careNote: Three cactus profiles share one root volume and one watering and weight history. Inspect each cactus, then judge the whole container before watering; a concern with one member is not a separate watering instruction.
P19.name: Shared rehab cactus planter
P19.setupNote: Shared rehabilitation planter, permanent label #1. Its care history follows the three remaining cacti through recovery and changes in growing conditions.

P20.careNote: The echeveria, two kalanchoes, and elephant bush have separate identity and care profiles but receive water through one shared root volume. Compare all four members and the whole-pot dry-down before watering.
P20.name: Shared succulent planter
P20.setupNote: Square wooden planter with a plastic liner and an approximately one-inch drainage hole through both layers. Outside dimensions have not been measured.

P30.careNote: Three visible botanical groups share this container. Judge the shared root volume by full dry-down and whole-pot weight; do not repeatedly wet the pot for one component while the others remain firm.
P30.name: Tiny mixed succulent planter
P30.setupNote: Setup 3, recorded October 8, 2026 at 8:12 p.m. EDT: pot described as 7 inch shallow, with Molly's Mix only. Photographs supplied October 22 show the green glazed round bowl. Usable internal depth and drainage remain unverified. The five-inch terra-cotta nursery-soil setup 2 is historical.

P35.careNote: Probable Lithops lesliei and probable Lithops salicola share one container and may replace their leaves at different times. Inspect both groups before watering. Keep dry while old leaves are being absorbed; wrinkles in one group alone are not enough reason to water the whole pot.
P35.name: Lithops shared planter
P35.setupNote: D'vine Dev Blush Mauve pot with 80% Molly's Succulent Mix and 20% perlite; repotted September 23, 2026 into setup 2. Recorded diameter: 4.2 in; sold as the 4.3-in variant. Four visible heads came from two nursery pots; their root connections are unknown.

P38.careNote: Houseplants aggregate with probable Fittonia albivenis and Hypoestes phyllostachya, tentative Pilea cf. depressa, and unidentified fern-like foliage and moss. Check moisture before watering; do not apply cactus dry-down rules. Seller care says lid closed and mist only when needed; briefly vent persistent heavy condensation. The reported 99% RH under the cap and seller's 90% suggestion do not establish a care target.
P38.name: Terrarium
P38.setupNote: P38 / #12, enrolled October 9, 2026. Glass jar with cork lid; seller-listed 6.3 × 3.9 in (16 × 10 cm); dimension orientation unverified. Variable live planting, hardscape, and substrate according to seller; no recipe or drainage confirmed. A mini sensor hangs below the cap. Photographs supplied October 22 show the jar on the desk to the right of the table display, without a new light reading. The October 10 report of a shelf near the cactus grow area and about 9,000 lux outside the nearest glass is historical; the proposed 7,000 lux adjustment remains unconfirmed. Internal dimensions, owner lid routine, and leaf-level light remain unrecorded.
